previous_record.text: About the Workshop: The Centre for Transportation and Logistics at IIMA continues its flagship Workshop on Advancing Research in Transportation Systems and Logistics Management, bringing together three days of interactive and intensive learning led by experienced IIMA faculty across six sessions. This year's edition centers on the theme of advanced research tools, sustainability, and next-generation skills, reflecting the evolving future of research and practice in the field of transportation and logistics.
